universal.label: Canadian Emergency Dispatch (Police, Fire, Paramedics)
universal.description: Universal emergency number across all Canadian provinces and territories for immediate Police, Fire, and Ambulance dispatch.

categories.name: Police & Public Safety
categories.description: RCMP, provincial, and municipal police emergency dispatch.

numbers.label: Police Emergency Response
numbers.audience: Anyone experiencing or witnessing a crime in progress, violent threat, or serious motor vehicle collision.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 911 immediately when life or property is in imminent danger. Bilingual service (English/French) + interpreter support.

categories.name: Medical & Crisis
categories.description: Paramedic ambulances, 988 Suicide Crisis Helpline, 811 nurse advice, and Poison Control.

numbers.label: Emergency Paramedic & Ambulance Dispatch
numbers.audience: Individuals with acute medical emergencies such as cardiac arrest, stroke, severe trauma, or anaphylaxis.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 911 immediately when rapid ambulance transport is required.

numbers.label: Suicide Crisis Helpline (Canada)
numbers.audience: Anyone in Canada thinking about suicide or worried about someone they know.
numbers.whenToUse: Call or text 988 toll-free in English or French for trauma-informed crisis support.

numbers.label: Provincial Health Link / Info-Santé Nurse Line
numbers.audience: Residents needing urgent non-emergency health advice from a registered nurse.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 811 to assess symptoms and find out whether you need to visit an emergency room or urgent care clinic.

numbers.label: Poison Control Canada (1-844-POISON-X)
numbers.audience: Anyone exposed to toxic substances, medications, or hazardous household chemicals.
numbers.whenToUse: Call immediately for poison triage and treatment instructions from toxicology specialists.

categories.name: Fire & Rescue
categories.description: Firefighters, hazardous materials response, and ice/water rescue.

numbers.label: Fire & Rescue Dispatch
numbers.audience: General public reporting structure fires, forest fires, carbon monoxide alarms, or rescues.
numbers.whenToUse: Exit the building immediately and call 911 from outside.

categories.name: Women & Child Safety
categories.description: Youth protection and domestic violence shelter network.

numbers.label: Kids Help Phone
numbers.audience: Children, teens, and young adults needing immediate crisis counselling or safety intervention.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 1-800-668-6868 or text CONNECT to 686868 for confidential support anywhere in Canada.

categories.name: Highway & Cyber Crime
categories.description: Provincial highway advisories and Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre.

numbers.label: Provincial Highway & Winter Road Service
numbers.audience: Drivers checking highway closures, winter blizzard conditions, and ferry/bridge incidents.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 511 for official provincial Ministry of Transportation highway updates (call 911 for highway crashes).

numbers.label: Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre (RCMP)
numbers.audience: Victims of identity theft, wire fraud, phishing, or cyber extortion.
numbers.whenToUse: Call after notifying your bank and local police to log a national fraud report.
